academic.f3: From the first day of JSS1 to the final WAEC paper in SSS3, our graduate teachers guide every student with patience and high expectations.
academic.f4_alt: JECK students at their desks in a classroom

l1.f2: Qualified teachers who explain clearly, check understanding and give extra help when a student needs it.
A standard curriculum that prepares students for higher learning anywhere in the world.
Students push each other to do better, and no one is left behind.

junior.f3: Strong basics in English, Mathematics, the sciences and the arts, with study habits that last. Students sit the Basic Education Certificate Examination (Junior WAEC) at the end of JSS3.
junior.f4: **Subjects include** English Language, Mathematics, Basic Science, Basic Technology, Social Studies, Civic Education, Computer Studies, Business Studies, Creative Arts, Christian Religious Studies, French and a Nigerian language.

senior.f3: Students choose a stream, with focused preparation for WAEC and NECO and guidance on university choices.

l1.f2: Physics, Chemistry, Biology and Further Mathematics.
Literature, Government, History and Christian Religious Studies.

laboratory.f3: Science students carry out practical work in our laboratory, measuring, testing and recording results just as real scientists do. Practicals build confidence for WAEC and NECO and spark a love for science.

library.f3: Our library is a favourite place for reading, research and quiet revision. Shelves of textbooks, novels and exam guides help students go beyond the classroom. Reading every day is a habit we build from JSS1.

computer_lab.f3: In the computer lab every student has a workstation of their own. They learn to type, use Microsoft Office, research online and build the digital skills they need for exams, university and work.

l1.f2: Three terms, from September to July
